identity.name: Carbon Brief
identity.description: A UK-based specialist climate publication producing data-driven analysis, explainers, fact-checks and investigations on climate science and policy.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Independent nonprofit climate publication funded by philanthropic foundations and grants; publishes funding disclosures. Leo Hickman is director and editor.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Nonprofit funding disclosures and a specialist editorial mission; coverage is evidence-heavy and policy-critical across governments.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Carbon Brief Left-Center with High factual reporting; its framing accepts mainstream climate science and decarbonisation as a policy goal.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic analysis is focused on energy transition and policy design rather than a general ideological programme.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Strong alignment with mainstream climate science, the Paris Agreement and decarbonisation policy, with substantial EU and UK coverage.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; Carbon Brief is known for data transparency, methodology notes and corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Specialist, data-led climate journalism. It explains policy and science through charts, scenarios and expert evidence, with an explicit decarbonisation lens.

selectionRationale: Provides authoritative climate and energy analysis that complements generalist environmental coverage and supports evidence-based event framing.

research.researchNotes: Official About page confirms specialist climate mission. Nonprofit ownership is recorded but current UI taxonomy lacks a nonprofit option. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
